domains.name: Comprensione della Lettura — Reading Comprehension (simple notices, messages, short texts)
Produzione Scritta — Written Production (fill forms, write short personal notes)
Comprensione dell'Ascolto — Listening Comprehension (short everyday dialogues, announcements)
Produzione Orale — Oral Production (describe yourself, respond to simple questions)

exam_price_notes: Approx. €65–€80 (~$72–$88 USD) depending on exam centre and country
exam_rules: No electronic devices or reference materials permitted. Oral exams conducted in person with a trained examiner. Listening tasks are played via audio recording; earphones not provided.
id_requirements: Valid government-issued photo ID (passport, national identity card, or equivalent) required at the exam centre.

lifecycle.summary: The issuer's CVCL centre (Universita per Stranieri di Perugia) lists the full live CELI ladder on its 'Esami CELI generici' page (last updated 27-03-2025): 'CELI Impatto (Livello A1 del QCER) CELI 1 (Livello A2 del QCER) CELI 2 (Livello B1 del QCER) CELI 3 (Livello B2 del QCER) CELI 4 (Livello C1 del QCER) CELI 5 (Livello C2 del QCER)', so CELI 1 (A2) is offered now. The site also runs live 'Iscrizione Esami CELI' and 'Calendario Esami CELI e DILS-PG' sections.

CILS Materiali di Preparazione (Official Sample Papers)

prerequisites.description: None; suitable for A2 level learners with basic Italian

renewal_options: CELI and CILS certificates have lifetime validity — they do not expire.

retake_policy.notes: No official waiting period. Candidates may re-sit at the next available exam session (exams held 2–4 times per year depending on centre and level).
